name: Magnet
description: Wrapper that pulls its children toward the cursor when the pointer comes near, using a spring simulation with optional tilt and scale, and settles back when the pointer leaves.
contents: Outer inline-block wrapper div with the interaction area
Inner div that receives the transform, wrapping any children
behavior: Children translate toward the pointer inside a padding zone around the wrapper, with pull easing out via smoothstep
Spring physics (stiffness, damping, mass) drives movement, tilt and scale, and the loop sleeps when at rest
Optional 3D tilt and scale toward the pointer
When exclusive, only the nearest magnet on the page reacts at once
Sets data-magnet-active attribute on the wrapper and calls onActiveChange while engaged
editableByProps: Children content, trigger distance, pull strength, max offset and axis lock
Tilt angle, hover scale and spring feel
Disabling, exclusive mode, active callback, classes, wrapper style and extra div attributes via rest props

needsCodeEdit.change: Ignore mouse and allow touch pointers
needsCodeEdit.where: pointerType check in onPointerMove inside attach

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the point where the pull starts to fade
needsCodeEdit.where: smoothstep call in the measure function

fixed: Registers global window listeners (pointermove, scroll, blur) and a documentElement pointerleave listener shared by all magnets, removed when the last one unmounts
Touch input does not trigger the effect, so there is no magnet effect on touch-only devices
Does nothing when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce
Wrapper is always position relative and inline-block, and the inner div uses will-change transform
Client component, requires a browser environment
